integrity: A spectral-decomposition and PBH proof covers the infinite family. Exact-rational finite verification is supplementary, with its checked cases and limits documented separately. Earlier zero-forcing, cograph control and consensus-filter theory are credited.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns exact algebraic Kalman controllability of the directly actuated discrete pair (f(hL), B_S), not the discretization of the full forced ODE with transformed inputs. Graphs are unweighted complete bipartite with both part sizes at least two. Strict convexity is sufficient and not claimed necessary. It does not address robustness, reachability conditioning, general weighted or multipartite graphs. RK2/RK4 positivity is asserted at the first stated resonance only. No independent mathematical review or publication-priority certification has been performed.
title: Strictly convex spectral filters and exact control resonances on complete bipartite networks
